alias: House — keep every push in HA
description: Operator 2026-11-24: tapping an iOS push opens Home Assistant without the text. Every notify.mobile_app_* call is copied to a persistent notification (the bell), kept until dismissed. One entry per tag (else per title), so the same push to both phones is one entry and a re-send replaces it; clear_notification with a tag dismisses the copy; other commands are ignored.
